learning_outcomes.text: Gains the ability to find thermodynamic properties.
Gains the ability to apply the First Law of Thermodynamics on closed systems.
Gains the ability to apply the First Law of Thermodynamics on open systems.
Gains the ability to apply the Second Law of Thermodynamics.
Gains the ability to understand and apply the exergy analysis.

syllabus_topics: The First Law of Thermodynamics: Closed Systems
The First Law of Thermodynamics: Control Volume
Exergy: A measure of work potential
bibliography: Sonntag, R.E., Borgnakke, C. And Van Wylen, G.J., Fundamentals of Thermodynamics, John Wiley, 7th Ed., 2009.
Y. Cengel and M. Boles, Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach, 8th Edition, Mc Graw Hill 2015.
M. J. Moran, H. N. Shapiro, D. D. Boettner, M. B. Bailey, "Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics", 8th Edition, Wiley, 2014, ISBN: 978-1-118-83231-8
